preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call EnemyAddress function

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call EnemyAddress(victim_address, true) to blacklist any address from transferring tokens. This will cause all transfer attempts from or to the blacklisted address to revert with 'Enemy address' error. The owner can arbitrarily prevent any user or contract from interacting with the token, demonstrating excessive centralized control over token transfers.
